concise, clear, landing naturally as a settled conclusion; not flat, not dramatic.

asr_text: In an e-book test, a warning and a sponsored label did not clearly lower choices of the sponsored book. The results suggest people may still want a product after seeing its ad. Shoppers should ask who the conversation helps.
